recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future changes to the external Patient $merge operation should be handled in the owning Administration incubator IG/repository, not by reintroducing old feedback text or editing removed core operation remnants.
issue_request: FHIR-7345 asked the Patient section to require server behavior for merged-off patient ids, suggesting redirect-like behavior. PA published a Not Persuasive with Modification disposition that declined to define required behavior and instead requested implementer-feedback notes in the Merging Patients section.
initial_application: Git commit bbed5fd4fc6658817d8723433b0c08a5027e8d41 explicitly applied the issue by adding a DSTU note to source/patient/patient-notes.xml asking for feedback on GET, search, reverse include, unlink, and related linked/merged patient behavior.
additional_context: FHIR-7938 is a duplicate of the same request. Later PA work for FHIR-19687 and the Patient Merge and Link project defined more specific merge behavior, and FHIR-38183 intentionally replaced the old Patient-page announcement with a link to Patient $merge. In 2025, Patient $merge was removed from the core operation list and Patient-page links were retargeted to the Administration incubator operation.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active Patient narrative distinguishes merging from linking and points to the current $merge operation page, while Patient-merge is no longer an active core operation in source/patient/list-Patient-operations.xml.
